welcome_offer.description: Variable welcome offer: apply and find out your welcome offer, as high as 90,000 Bonus Miles after you spend $3,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer; American Express shows the exact amount after you apply. No fixed public offer amount is published.
